caption: The video captures a night-sky fireworks display against black, with a fan-shaped golden fountain at the bottom center and a thin power line crossing the frame. Two white starbursts already open at the top expand into larger golden radial bursts, then a bright flash erupts at the right. Multiple golden starbursts spread across the upper half while the central band of blue-white dots fades. The golden streaks develop dense clusters of twinkling white dots that slowly dim, and the fountain dissolves into smoke. The aerial points decay into sparse faint twinkles against the dark sky. A new bright white fountain then flares at the bottom center, growing and producing smoke.
